content.user_title: Append Plain Text to Google Docs
content.value_statement: Adding a short update to an existing document can interrupt a larger workflow. This skill prepares and runs a confirmed Google Workspace CLI append operation.
actual_capabilities: Appends supplied plain text to the end of an existing Google Docs document.
Targets a document by its required Google Docs document ID.
Uses the gws docs +write command with document and text parameters.
Requests user confirmation before performing the document write.
Directs rich-formatting tasks to the raw batchUpdate API.
limitations: It appends plain text only and does not apply rich formatting.
It requires the gws CLI, authentication, and access to the target document.
It does not create documents, replace existing text, or insert text at a chosen position.
It requires both a document ID and the exact text to append.

use_cases.title: Record project updates
use_cases.description: Append a confirmed plain-text status update to a shared project document.

use_cases.title: Add support notes
use_cases.description: Place an approved case summary at the end of a team reference document.

use_cases.title: Publish operational logs
use_cases.description: Append concise deployment or maintenance notes to an existing operations document.

prompt_templates.title: Append a short note
prompt_templates.prompt: Append the exact text "{text}" to Google Docs document {document_id}. Show the planned action and request confirmation before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has the document ID and final text.

prompt_templates.title: Add a meeting summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Append this plain-text meeting summary to document {document_id}: {summary}. Preserve the supplied wording and request confirmation before writing.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team member needs to record approved meeting notes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an audited update
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an append operation for document {document_id} using {text}. Verify the document ID is present, then request confirmation before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: A coordinator wants to review the target and content before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Append generated release notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert {release_details} into concise plain-text release notes. Present the final text, then request confirmation before appending it to document {document_id}.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced workflow transforms source details before a controlled document update.

output_examples.input: Append "Budget approved for phase two." to document 1AbC, but ask before writing.
output: Planned update: append "Budget approved for phase two." to document 1AbC.
Confirmation required: proceed with this document write?

output_examples.input: Add the approved meeting summary to the shared notes document.
output: Target: the supplied shared notes document.
Content: the approved plain-text meeting summary.
Confirmation required before appending the text.

best_practices: Confirm the exact document ID and final text before every write.
Use plain text here, and use the raw batchUpdate API when formatting is required.
Authenticate with the least privilege needed and verify access to the target document.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a document write without explicit user confirmation.
Do not append secrets or sensitive content without clear authorization.
Do not use this skill for text replacement, positioned insertion, or rich formatting.

faq.question: Where does the new text appear?
faq.answer: The skill inserts the text at the end of the document body.

faq.question: Can this skill create a new document?
faq.answer: No. It appends text to an existing document identified by its document ID.

faq.question: Does it support rich formatting?
faq.answer: No. Use the raw Google Docs batchUpdate API for formatting.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the gws CLI, configure authentication, and ensure the account can edit the target document.

faq.question: Does the skill ask before writing?
faq.answer: Yes. Its instructions require user confirmation before executing the write command.

faq.question: Which inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide the target document ID and the plain text that should be appended.
